headline: Kazunari Yamaguchi resigns as Whole-time Director, continues as Non-executive Director; Sarada Prasana Nayak appointed Head (Production)
why: Senior management changes in production impact operational strategy, plant expansion, and manufacturing efficiency.

people.name: Mr. Sarada Prasana Nayak
people.role: Senior Management Personnel (SMP) designated as Head (Production and Production Engineering)
people.background: Over 30 years of experience in planning large scale CAPEX programs, setting up green field and brown field projects, new product introduction, localization, supplier development, new technologies, and carbon neutral initiatives. Alumnus of Utkal university and Ravenshaw College, Odisha; graduate in Mechanical Engineering.
